prompt:
[teasing, punchy] This guy has started his new life forty-seven times. And every time, it's Monday.

[long pause]

[dry] It's Monday.

[long pause]

[dry, deadpan] Why?

[long pause]

[warm] Fresh starts can help. But a perfect date doesn't replace a plan.

[long pause]

[explaining] Choose one action. Decide exactly when and where. Like reading one page after breakfast.

[long pause]

[warm, playful] And if you miss Monday? Tuesday works too.

[long pause]

[dry, grinning] What about after breakfast?

[excited, shouting] Monday, I'm changing EVERYTHING!

[long pause]

[sheepish] Next Monday.

[long pause]

[dramatic] Because I need a fresh start!

[long pause]

[hopeful] What about next year?
